```{python}
#| label: fig-jtag
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "JTAG boundary scan on a PCB: the boundary-scan cells (small squares) at every pin of each IC form a serial shift register; the chain runs from TDI through all devices to TDO, controlled by TCK and TMS. This allows forcing and observing all pins, and thus testing the PCB interconnects between the ICs."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, FancyArrowPatch

RED = '#b02020'
BLUE = '#1f4fb0'
GREY = '#555555'


def line(ax, xs, ys, color='k', lw=1.1):
    ax.plot(xs, ys, '-', color=color, lw=lw, solid_capstyle='projecting',
            solid_joinstyle='miter')


def arr(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, color='k', lw=1.1):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((x0, y0), (x1, y1), arrowstyle='->',
                                 mutation_scale=9, lw=lw, color=color,
                                 shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0))


def wire(ax, pts, color='k', lw=1.1):
    """Polyline with an arrowhead on the last segment."""
    xs, ys = zip(*pts)
    if len(pts) > 2:
        line(ax, xs[:-1], ys[:-1], color, lw)
    arr(ax, *pts[-2], *pts[-1], color=color, lw=lw)


def dot(ax, x, y, color='k'):
    ax.plot(x, y, 'o', color=color, ms=3.5)


W, H = 3.4, 3.2     # chip size
Y = 2.3             # chip bottom edge
CS = 0.4            # boundary-scan cell size
ROWS = (1.2, 1.9, 2.6)  # cell centres relative to chip bottom


def chip(ax, x, name):
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x, Y), W, H, fc='#e8eef4', ec='k', lw=1.2,
                           zorder=1))
    # core logic and TAP controller
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x + 0.95, Y + 1.0), W - 1.9, 1.8, fc='white',
                           ec=GREY, lw=0.8))
    ax.text(x + W / 2, Y + 1.9, name + '\ncore', ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=8.5)
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x + W / 2 - 0.5, Y + 0.2), 1.0, 0.55,
                           fc='white', ec=GREY, lw=0.8))
    ax.text(x + W / 2, Y + 0.475, 'TAP', ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=7)

    xl, xr = x + 0.4, x + W - 0.4        # cell column centres
    for cx in (xl, xr):
        for r in ROWS:
            ax.add_patch(Rectangle((cx - CS / 2, Y + r - CS / 2), CS, CS,
                                   fc='#f4c542', ec='k', lw=0.7, zorder=3))
            # cell to core
            cxi = cx + CS / 2 if cx == xl else cx - CS / 2
            core = x + 0.95 if cx == xl else x + W - 0.95
            line(ax, [cxi, core], [Y + r] * 2, GREY, 0.7)

    # scan chain inside the chip: TDI -> left cells -> right cells -> TDO
    yb, yt = Y + ROWS[0], Y + ROWS[-1]
    wire(ax, [(xl, Y), (xl, yb - CS / 2)], RED)
    for r0, r1 in zip(ROWS[:-1], ROWS[1:]):
        arr(ax, xl, Y + r0 + CS / 2, xl, Y + r1 - CS / 2, RED)
    ytop = Y + H - 0.25
    wire(ax, [(xl, yt + CS / 2), (xl, ytop), (xr, ytop),
              (xr, yt + CS / 2)], RED)
    for r0, r1 in zip(ROWS[:0:-1], ROWS[-2::-1]):
        arr(ax, xr, Y + r0 - CS / 2, xr, Y + r1 + CS / 2, RED)
    line(ax, [xr, xr], [yb - CS / 2, Y], RED)
    return xl, xr, x + W / 2


fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.5))

# PCB
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0.2, 0.2), 16.2, 5.8, fc='#e9f4e6', ec='k', lw=1.0,
                       zorder=0))
ax.text(0.4, 5.65, 'PCB', fontsize=9)

# JTAG header
Y_TDI, Y_TCK, Y_TMS, Y_TDO = 1.75, 1.3, 0.95, 0.6
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0.5, 0.35), 0.9, 1.7, fc='#d8d8d8', ec='k', lw=1.0))
ax.text(0.95, 2.2, 'JTAG', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)
for yy, name, col in ((Y_TDI, 'TDI', RED), (Y_TCK, 'TCK', GREY),
                      (Y_TMS, 'TMS', GREY), (Y_TDO, 'TDO', RED)):
    ax.text(1.5, yy + 0.05, name, fontsize=6.5, color=col, va='bottom')

chips = [chip(ax, x, n) for x, n in ((2.6, 'IC 1'), (7.4, 'IC 2'),
                                      (12.2, 'IC 3'))]

# interconnect nets under test between neighbouring chips
for (_, xr, _), (xl, _, _) in zip(chips[:-1], chips[1:]):
    for r in ROWS:
        line(ax, [xr + CS / 2, xl - CS / 2], [Y + r] * 2, BLUE, 1.4)
ax.text(2.6 + W + 0.7, Y + ROWS[0] - 0.25, 'nets\nunder test',
        ha='center', va='top', fontsize=7, color=BLUE)

# board-level scan chain: header TDI -> IC1 -> IC2 -> IC3 -> header TDO
wire(ax, [(1.4, Y_TDI), (chips[0][0], Y_TDI), (chips[0][0], Y)], RED)
for (_, xr, _), (xl, _, _) in zip(chips[:-1], chips[1:]):
    wire(ax, [(xr, Y), (xr, Y_TDI), (xl, Y_TDI), (xl, Y)], RED)
wire(ax, [(chips[-1][1], Y), (chips[-1][1], Y_TDO), (1.4, Y_TDO)], RED)

# TCK / TMS bus to the TAP controller of every chip
for yy, dx in ((Y_TCK, -0.25), (Y_TMS, 0.25)):
    xend = chips[-1][2] + dx
    line(ax, [1.4, xend], [yy, yy], GREY)
    for i, (_, _, xc) in enumerate(chips):
        arr(ax, xc + dx, yy, xc + dx, Y + 0.2, GREY)
        if i < len(chips) - 1:
            dot(ax, xc + dx, yy, GREY)

ax.set_xlim(0.1, 16.5)
ax.set_ylim(0.1, 6.1)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
